source: S&P Dow Jones Indices, Shariah Indices Scorecard

risk_free_proxy.description: RBA cash rate target, used as a static risk-free proxy for Sharpe ratio calculations
risk_free_proxy.limitation: Applied flatly across 3-year and 5-year windows; the actual RBA cash rate was materially lower for part of both windows, so Sharpe ratios here understate risk-adjusted performance relative to the rate that actually prevailed at each point in time.

notes: P/CF (price-to-cash-flow) omitted from valuation comparison: the conventional index's published figure (99.0) is an outlier consistent with a near-zero aggregate cash-flow denominator, not a meaningful multiple.
Sharpe ratio = (annualized return - risk_free_proxy) / annualized volatility.
This is published index-level data (an audited, live-tracked S&P index), not a stock-by-stock backtest constructed from raw price history.
